# MiniDev UI

> 506 free, MIT-licensed React + Tailwind v4 components for product UI: forms, data tables, charts, billing, auth, settings, overlays, and AI surfaces (chat, reasoning, tool calls). Built on Base UI. Hairline design language: 1px structure, semantic OKLCH tokens, light + dark from one token set.

## Install

- npm: `npm i minidev-ui-kit` then `import { Button } from "minidev-ui-kit/ui/button"` (Next.js: add `transpilePackages: ["minidev-ui-kit"]`)
- shadcn CLI, one file at a time: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/<name>.json`
- Or copy the single source file into your repo. Every component is one file.

## Rules for generating code with MiniDev UI

- Use semantic tokens only: bg, surface, raised, sunken, border, border-strong, fg, fg-muted, fg-subtle, ink, on-ink, accent, accent-soft, accent-fg, success, warning, danger, info. Never raw hex or palette steps like blue-500.
- Primary actions use <Button> (ink). Brand-coloured actions use <Button variant="accent">. Secondary: variant="outline". Quiet: variant="ghost".
- Depth: shadow-xs, shadow-sm, shadow-raised (cards), shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-overlay (menus, dialogs). No other shadows.
- Radius: controls rounded-lg (8px), cards rounded-xl (12px), overlays rounded-2xl. Nested radius = outer minus padding.
- Numbers are tabular (tabular-nums). Headings use negative tracking; body text does not.
- Dark mode: add the `dark` class to <html>. Components never branch on theme.

## Components (377)

- [Accordion](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/accordion): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/accordion.json`. Accessible React accordion on Base UI, with bordered items, a rotating chevron and animated panels. Keyboard navigable, with one or many items open at once.
- [AccountSetupProgress](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/account-setup-progress): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/account-setup-progress.json`. React onboarding card that shows account setup as completed steps out of a total, with a labelled progress bar and a hint for the next step to finish.
- [ActivityFeed](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/activity-feed): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/activity-feed.json`. React activity feed that lists who did what and when, with initials avatars, muted action text and tabular timestamps in a single bordered card.
- [AddCardForm](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/add-card-form): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/add-card-form.json`. Compact payment form for card number, expiry and CVC with correct autocomplete hints, numeric input mode and a full width save button. Ready for your processor.
- [AdminStatStrip](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/admin-stat-strip): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/admin-stat-strip.json`. Responsive Tailwind row of admin KPI tiles, each with a label, a large tabular value and an optional up or down delta. Collapses from four columns to one.
- [AdminUserRow](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/admin-user-row): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/admin-user-row.json`. User management row with avatar, online status dot, name, email, a role chip for admin, write or read access, and an accessible actions menu button.
- [AgentTrace](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/agent-trace): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/agent-trace.json`. React timeline of an AI agent run: each tool step shows pending, running, done or error, reports its duration and folds out details. The header sums up the run.
- [AiComposer](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/ai-composer): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/ai-composer.json`. Chat input for AI apps with a multiline textarea, Enter to send, suggestion chips, attach button, model picker and a stop button while a response streams.
- [AlertDialog](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/alert-dialog): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/alert-dialog.json`. Shadcn style alert dialog on Base UI for confirmations that need an explicit answer. Modal backdrop, focus trap, title, description and an actions row.
- [AnnouncementBar](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/announcement-bar): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/announcement-bar.json`. Slim site-wide announcement bar for launches, promos or notices. Centered content, a polite status role for screen readers and an optional dismiss button.
- [ApiKeyList](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/api-key-list): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/api-key-list.json`. React settings panel listing API keys with masked previews, created date badges and a rotate button per key, plus a header action to create a new key.
- [AppShell](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/app-shell): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/app-shell.json`. Tailwind app shell layout with a fixed width sidebar slot, a topbar slot and a scrolling main area. The sidebar hides below the md breakpoint for mobile.
- [ApprovalCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/approval-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/approval-card.json`. React request card for approval workflows showing the requester avatar, title and summary, with Reject and Approve buttons wired to your callbacks.
- [AreaChart](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/area-chart): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/area-chart.json`. Dependency free SVG area chart for React with a smoothed line, dashed grid, gradient fill and an optional highlighted point. Strokes stay crisp at any size.
- [ArtifactPreview](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/artifact-preview): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/artifact-preview.json`. Framed preview for AI generated artifacts such as code, documents or UI, with a title bar, copy button and optional expand action for a full view.
- [AspectRatio](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/aspect-ratio): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/aspect-ratio.json`. Shadcn compatible aspect ratio wrapper that locks media to a ratio such as 16:9 or 1:1 using CSS aspect-ratio, with overflow clipped for images and video.
- [AssignPicker](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/assign-picker): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/assign-picker.json`. Assignee picker for tasks and tickets: a listbox of people with initials avatars, where the selected person is highlighted and choices report their id.
- [AttachmentChip](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/attachment-chip): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/attachment-chip.json`. Compact Tailwind file chip with a paperclip icon, truncated filename and an optional remove button, for attachments in chat composers, emails and forms.
- [AudioPlayer](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audio-player): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/audio-player.json`. Minimal React audio player row with a play and pause toggle, title, subtitle and an accessible progress bar. Controlled, so it works with any audio source.
- [AuditFilterBar](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audit-filter-bar): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/audit-filter-bar.json`. Filter toolbar for audit logs combining a search field, actor filter chips for all, admins or system, and a date range picker in one wrapping row.
- [AuditLogEntry](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audit-log-entry): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/audit-log-entry.json`. Single audit log line: actor avatar, actor name, muted action text and the affected target, with a relative timestamp underneath. Stacks into a trail.
- [AuditTrail](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/audit-trail): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/audit-trail.json`. Bordered audit trail in React that renders a list of actor, action, target and time records as stacked log entries. Useful for security and admin history pages.
- [AuthCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/auth-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/auth-card.json`. Centered Tailwind sign in card with a title, optional description, a slot for fields and providers, and a divided footer for sign up or reset links.
- [Autocomplete](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/autocomplete): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/autocomplete.json`. Text input that filters string options as you type, using ARIA combobox and listbox roles. Works controlled or uncontrolled and lists up to eight matches.
- [AvatarUpload](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/avatar-upload): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/avatar-upload.json`. React profile photo uploader with an avatar preview and an Upload button that opens a hidden image file input. Shows initials until a picture is chosen.
- [Avatar](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/avatar): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/avatar.json`. Shadcn compatible avatar on Base UI with image and initials fallback, three sizes, a status badge and an overlapping avatar group with a plus count.
- [BackLink](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/back-link): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/back-link.json`. Small back navigation link with a left arrow icon, muted text that darkens on hover and a visible focus ring. Defaults to the label Back and accepts any href.
- [BackToTop](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/back-to-top): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/back-to-top.json`. A back to top button that appears after scrolling, with a ring that fills as the reader progresses. Smooth scroll that respects reduced motion.
- [Badge](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/badge): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/badge.json`. Shadcn style badge in seven variants: default, accent, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost and link. Renders as a span or any element, with icon support.
- [Banner](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/banner): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/banner.json`. Inline notice banner in accent, warning or danger tones, with a status role, a slot for an action button and an optional dismiss icon on the right.
- [BarChart](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bar-chart): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/bar-chart.json`. Lightweight React bar chart with rounded bars, dashed gridlines and labels. Hovering a bar dims the rest and shows its value; the peak is highlighted first.
- [BentoGrid](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bento-grid): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/bento-grid.json`. A responsive bento grid for feature sections: tiles with icon, title, copy and a visual slot on a six column grid that collapses to one column on phones.
- [BillingAddress](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/billing-address): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/billing-address.json`. Tailwind billing address fieldset with a multiline street field and a responsive row for city, state and postal code. Drops into checkout forms.
- [BlogCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/blog-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/blog-card.json`. Linked Tailwind blog post card with a 16:9 cover image, tag, relative date, title and a two line clamped excerpt. Hover and focus states cover the card.
- [BreadcrumbEllipsis](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/breadcrumb-ellipsis): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/breadcrumb-ellipsis.json`. Ellipsis marker for collapsing the middle of long breadcrumb trails. Decorative and hidden from assistive tech, sized to sit between breadcrumb separators.
- [Breadcrumb](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/breadcrumb): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/breadcrumb.json`. Breadcrumb navigation from an items array, with chevron separators, linked ancestors and the current page marked with aria-current. Built with React.
- [BuildPipeline](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/build-pipeline): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/build-pipeline.json`. CI pipeline view that shows each stage as a chip with success, running, failed or pending icons, joined by connectors. Status text is exposed to screen readers.
- [BulkActionsBar](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bulk-actions-bar): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/bulk-actions-bar.json`. Floating Tailwind selection bar that appears once rows are selected, showing the count, your action buttons and a clear button. Sticks to the bottom edge.
- [BulkUserImport](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/bulk-user-import): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/bulk-user-import.json`. CSV user import panel with a format hint for email, name and role, a CSV-only dropzone and an Import users button that enables once a file is added.
- [ButtonGroup](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/button-group): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/button-group.json`. Groups adjacent buttons into one segmented control in Tailwind, joining borders and rounding only the outer corners. Uses role group for toolbars.
- [Button](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/button): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/button.json`. Shadcn compatible React button on Base UI with eight variants, nine sizes including icon sizes, a pressed state and render prop support for links.
- [CalendarAgenda](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/calendar-agenda): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/calendar-agenda.json`. React agenda list of the day's events with a fixed time column, title and optional meta line such as location or attendees, divided inside one card.
- [CalendarMonth](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/calendar-month): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/calendar-month.json`. Month calendar grid with weekday headers and clickable day cells that highlight the selected date. A simple Tailwind base for date views and schedulers.
- [Callout](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/callout): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/callout.json`. Tailwind callout box in info, success, warning or danger tones with an optional bold title. Uses the note role, which suits docs, forms and setup steps.
- [CancelFlow](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cancel-flow): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/cancel-flow.json`. Two step subscription cancellation flow: ask for a reason with radio options, then confirm with a destructive button or go back. Tells users what they keep.
- [Card](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/card.json`. Shadcn compatible card with header, title, description, action, content and footer slots, a compact size and edge to edge images. Built for Tailwind v4.
- [Carousel](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/carousel): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/carousel.json`. Scroll snap React carousel with previous and next buttons, arrow key support and a labelled region. Shows one, two or three slides by breakpoint, no library.
- [CartLineItem](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cart-line-item): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/cart-line-item.json`. React shopping cart row with product title, unit price, a quantity stepper and an optional remove button. Callbacks report quantity changes and removals.
- [CaseStudyCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/case-study-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/case-study-card.json`. Case study card with the company name, a short headline and a large result metric, plus an optional up or down delta. Good for proof sections on landing pages.
- [Center](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/center): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/center.json`. Layout helper that centers content horizontally and vertically in a narrow, text-centered column. Handy for empty states, auth screens and simple heroes.
- [CharacterCount](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/character-count): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/character-count.json`. Live React character counter that shows the current count against a limit and turns red when it goes over. Announces changes politely to screen readers.
- [ChartCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chart-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/chart-card.json`. Card wrapper for charts with a title, optional description and a minimum height body. Pairs with the area, bar and donut charts in a React dashboard.
- [ChartLegend](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chart-legend): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/chart-legend.json`. Wrapping chart legend with small color swatches and labels. Pass colors per series or fall back to accent, success, warning and danger theme tokens.
- [ChartTooltipCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chart-tooltip-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/chart-tooltip-card.json`. Tooltip card for charts showing a title and label and value rows with tabular numbers. Drop it into any chart library's custom tooltip slot.
- [ChatThread](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chat-thread): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/chat-thread.json`. Scrolling chat thread for React that renders user, assistant and system messages as bubbles, auto scrolls to the newest one and uses a live log role.
- [CheckRunList](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/check-run-list): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/check-run-list.json`. List of CI check runs with success, failed or running icons, monospaced job names and a status label. Looks like the checks section of a pull request.
- [CheckboxGroup](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkbox-group): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/checkbox-group.json`. Vertical wrapper that groups related checkboxes under role group with even spacing. Use it with Checkbox and labels for multi select settings.
- [Checkbox](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkbox): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/checkbox.json`. Shadcn style checkbox on Base UI with an animated check, indeterminate state, invalid and disabled styles, and an enlarged hit area for touch.
- [CheckoutSummary](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/checkout-summary): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/checkout-summary.json`. Tailwind order summary card listing line items and prices, a divided total row and a full width Pay now button. Fits the side column of a checkout.
- [ChipFilter](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/chip-filter): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/chip-filter.json`. Single select filter chips in React that behave as a radio group, with an accent ring on the active chip. Good for quick filters above lists and tables.
- [ChoiceCard](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/choice-card): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/choice-card.json`. Selectable React card button with an icon, title and description, using aria-pressed and an accent outline when chosen. Suits plan pickers and onboarding.
- [CitationChip](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/citation-chip): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/citation-chip.json`. Inline citation button for AI answers, with an accent source number and label. Link it to a source panel or popover so users can check references.
- [Cluster](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cluster): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/cluster.json`. Flex layout primitive that wraps children in a row with vertical centering and a numeric gap on the 4px scale. Great for tags, buttons and meta rows.
- [CodeBlock](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/code-block): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/code-block.json`. React code block with zero dependency syntax coloring, a language tag, optional filename and line numbers, and a copy button that confirms Copied.

- [ColorPicker](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/color-picker): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/color-picker.json`. Swatch color picker with eight OKLCH presets, a ring on the selected swatch and listbox semantics. Works controlled or uncontrolled for theme or label colors.

Columns dropdown for data tables with a checkbox item per column. It returns the updated list of visible column ids so you can show or hide table columns.

- [CommandPalette](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/command-palette): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/command-palette.json`. Cmd K style command palette in a dialog with a search field that filters commands as you type, runs the chosen action and closes. Shows an empty state.
- [CommentComposer](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/comment-composer): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/comment-composer.json`. Comment box with a three row textarea and a Comment button that stays disabled until there is text. Submits the trimmed value and clears the field.
- [CommentThread](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/comment-thread): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/comment-thread.json`. Threaded React comment list with initials avatars, author name, timestamp and body in bordered bubbles. Pairs with the comment composer.
- [CommitRow](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/commit-row): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/commit-row.json`. Git commit row for React with author avatar, commit message, relative time, a short SHA badge and a copy button for the hash. Fits deploy logs.

- [ConfirmDestructive](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/confirm-destructive): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/confirm-destructive.json`. Destructive action confirm: a red trigger button opens a dialog with a title, warning text, Cancel and Confirm. Labels are configurable for deletes and resets.
- [ConnectedAccount](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/connected-account): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/connected-account.json`. Tailwind settings row for a linked third party account showing the provider and account name, with a Disconnect button. For OAuth and integrations.
- [ConsoleOutput](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/console-output): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/console-output.json`. Scrollable Tailwind console panel in monospace that prints log, warn and error lines with level labels. Uses a log role and is keyboard focusable.
- [Container](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/container): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/container.json`. Responsive page container that centers content with side padding and a max width preset: sm, default, lg or full. The basic wrapper for Tailwind layouts.
- [ContextChip](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-chip): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/context-chip.json`. Small toggle chip for picking context in AI prompts or filters, with an active accent state and hover styling. Passes through all native button props.
- [ContextMenu](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-menu): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/context-menu.json`. Right click context menu that opens at the cursor with menu items, including destructive items in red. Closes on selection or click outside, in React.
- [ContextPill](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/context-pill): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/context-pill.json`. Rounded pill for showing attached context, such as files or pages in an AI prompt, with a truncated label and an optional remove button.
- [ConversationSidebar](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/conversation-sidebar): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/conversation-sidebar.json`. React chat history sidebar with a New chat button and a scrolling list of conversations showing title and relative time. Highlights the active chat.
- [CookieBanner](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/cookie-banner): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/cookie-banner.json`. Floating React cookie consent card fixed to the corner, with a short notice and Accept and Reject buttons. It is a labelled dialog for assistive tech.
- [CopyButton](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/copy-button): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/copy-button.json`. React copy to clipboard button that writes a value, then swaps to a check icon and Copied label for a moment. Accepts every Button variant and size.
- [CopyId](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/copy-id): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/copy-id.json`. Monospaced ID chip that copies its value to the clipboard on click and shows a check when done. Good for API keys, order IDs and record UUIDs.
- [CouponInput](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/coupon-input): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/coupon-input.json`. Promo code field with an Apply button and inline success or error messages. The demo validation is easy to replace with your own check in React.
- [CoverageMeter](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/coverage-meter): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/coverage-meter.json`. Test coverage bar with a label and percentage that turns green at 80, amber at 60 and red below. Exposed as a progressbar for screen readers.
- [CreateApiKey](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/create-api-key): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/create-api-key.json`. Inline form to name and create an API key, with a labelled input and a Create key button that passes the name to your handler. Pairs with the key list.

- [DangerZone](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/danger-zone): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/danger-zone.json`. Danger zone settings card with a red outline, a warning that the action cannot be undone and a destructive delete button. Put it last on settings pages.
- [DataTable](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/data-table): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/data-table.json`. React data table with sortable columns, row selection, a floating bulk actions bar, hover row actions, sticky header, three densities and skeleton loading.
- [DatePicker](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-picker): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/date-picker.json`. Date picker built on the native date input, styled to match the rest of your form fields. Returns ISO date strings and supports disabled and labelled states.
- [DateRangePicker](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/date-range-picker): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/date-range-picker.json`. Start and end date range picker made from two labelled date inputs. Works controlled or uncontrolled and returns a from and to object for filters and reports.

Account deletion step with a danger alert and a confirmation field: the delete button stays disabled until the user types DELETE. Guards against misclicks.

- [LiveComponentRail](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/live-component-rail): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/live-component-rail.json`. A rail of live component cards, including buttons, a badge, a switch and a destructive action, that rise into view with a quick stagger on scroll.

- [MagneticCta](https://ui.minidev.pro/docs/magnetic-cta): `npx shadcn@latest add https://ui.minidev.pro/r/magnetic-cta.json`. A magnetic button that drifts toward the cursor on a spring and snaps back on leave. Takes all Button props plus a strength value; static for reduced motion.

A gradient text headline that wipes in from left to right with a clip path reveal when it scrolls into view. Accepts any children as the heading text.
